Chapter 824: Chapter 24: The Deceased Pioneer of the Mystic Realm (Added Release, Asking for Monthly Tickets at the Beginning of the Month)

The Boundless Void is vast and immense, but in Lin Yuan’s eyes, with a mere thought, he could appear anywhere.

This is an ability that comes with attaining a certain mastery over space and time.

Lin Yuan, in the Sixfold Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules, has already stepped into the threshold of the mighty.

The Void Secret Realm lies deep within the multilayered spatial layers of the Boundless Void, surrounded by spatial-temporal mazes.

Even for Sect Master Duan Xie, who is at Level Eleven Perfect, he would need to rely on a scroll token to enter....

But these spatial-temporal mazes cannot stop Lin Yuan.

When he was in the Five-Layered Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rules, Lin Yuan could already forcefully enter the Void Secret Realm.

Now, in the Space-Time Fusion Rule Sixfold Realm, the entire Void Secret Realm, inside and out, every single area, holds no secrets before Lin Yuan.

It’s like his own backyard.

Even if Lin Yuan wished to, he could completely create a new ‘Void Secret Realm’.

One that is even more perfect and grander than the original.

The Tenth Stage Evil Gods of the Boundless Void, to a certain degree, have also just barely reached the sixth realm in their understanding of space and time.

But such sixth realm is based on innate talent.

Unlike Lin Yuan, who comprehended the Sixfold Realm of Spatiotemporal Fusion Rules from scratch entirely through his Against-Heaven’s Understanding.

There is still a significant gap in that respect. “Enter by myself?”

The Child of the Void is utterly astonished.

The Void Secret Realm is the result of its creator’s painstaking efforts.

Even if Lin Yuan stepped into the Tenth Stage, forcefully entering the Void Secret Realm isn’t doubted by the Child of the Void.

However, to think of descending into the core area of the secret realm without his permission…

Do they really think that the painstaking efforts of the secret realm creator are mere paper?

But the next moment.

The Child of the Void, the holder of the secret realm, vaguely felt the presence of the Martial Ancestor descending into the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm and appearing without warning at the core.

In that process, many spatiotemporal barriers and traps in the secret realm, in front of the Martial Ancestor, didn’t even have the chance to be activated, as if the Martial Ancestor and he himself were both masters of the Void Secret Realm. “This?”

The Child of the Void’s face slightly pales.

In fact, even when the Child of the Void knew that the Martial Ancestor had stepped into the Tenth Stage, he still was somewhat confident.

If the Martial Ancestor’s demands were truly excessive.

Such as planning to completely enslave him, or having thoughts of killing him to seize the Void Secret Realm.

The Child of the Void would definitely refuse.

He could just hide in the core area of the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, where even a being of the Tenth Stage would not forcibly enter.

This was also one of the few pieces of information left to him, the heir of the secret realm, by its creator.

The creation of the Void Secret Realm was based on the Boundless Void.

Unless one completely surpasses the creator in the understanding of space and time, another being of the Tenth Stage couldn’t entirely occupy the Void Secret Realm.

But now?

The Child of the Void realized just how laughable his final trump card was before the Martial Ancestor.

If it weren’t for his still retained control over the Void Secret Realm, the Child of the Void almost thought the realm had changed hands. “Fortunately, I didn’t say too much earlier…”

The Child of the Void greatly relieves inwardly, thankful that he hadn’t immediately agreed to the Martial Ancestor earlier, instead choosing to use the secret realm as his last resort to negotiate terms with the Martial Ancestor.

Otherwise, the ending waiting for him probably wouldn’t have been good.

The Child of the Void has no doubts the Martial Ancestor would kill him—among such mighty beings, who doesn’t reign supreme? Before the Martial Ancestor, the previous holders of the Void Secret Realm did the same. … “Did the Martial Ancestor not notice me?” Tianzhi True Lord greatly relieved, among the numerous Evil Gods at the scene, he had the biggest connection with the Martial Ancestor.

Not only did he send an incarnation to infiltrate the Tianqing World and was suppressed on-site by the Martial Ancestor, but he also planned many Evil God True Lords to ambush the Taiyin Sovereign.

And given the relationship between Taiyin Sovereign and the Martial Ancestor, it would be only too normal for the Martial Ancestor to kill Tianzhi True Lord. “Perhaps in the eyes of the Martial Ancestor, he has never truly acknowledged me…” Tianzhi True Lord doesn’t know whether to be glad or disappointed, he considers his ‘wisdom’ significant, but before such absolute power of the Martial Ancestor, even the greatest wisdom is pale and weak. …

In the deepest area of the Void Secret Realm.

Lin Yuan is idly observing the surroundings.

Before reaching the Sixth Realm of Space-Time, the Taiyang Divine Spirit often ventured within the realm, yet still unable to break through several barriers deep in the realm.

But now, Lin Yuan just stepped in with a stride. “The Tenth Stage Evil Gods, in mastering the power of space-time, are about the same as the Sixth Realm, but they are lacking in the finer details compared to the Sixth Realm,” Lin Yuan concluded after observing the Void Secret Realm for a while.

This is the difference between relying on innate talent and solely on one’s own capabilities.

In the early stages, Evil Gods could overpower Martial Tao cultivators.

But as the strength and realm continue to increase, this gap will quickly narrow and eventually turn in favor. “But where exactly did that creator of the secret realm go to?”

Lin Yuan is slightly curious, a Tenth Stage Evil God, existing between Level Eleven Perfect to Level Twelve in the Main Universe.

Such a mighty life form, even placed in the Main Universe, could live from the creation to the collapse and destruction of the universe, completing an entire Cosmic Era.

This boundless void has clearly not yet experienced destruction and collapse, as the legends of the secret realm’s creator still exist, and the Void Secret Realm is also present, so theoretically, the creator of the secret realm should still be alive.

Originally, Lin Yuan thought that the creator of the secret realm was hidden in some corner, asleep, but after stepping into the Sixth Realm of Space-Time Fusion Rule, Lin Yuan searched the entire boundless void but could not find any trace of the creator of the secret realm. “Here?”

Lin Yuan looked around, he was now at the core area of the deepest part of the Void Secret Realm, which was a vast desert environment.

Lin Yuan was standing in the middle of the desert, in front of him stood several huge stone pillars.

Lin Yuan’s gaze swept over those huge stone pillars, which retained some information left by the creator of the secret realm, simply instructing the future controllers of the secret realm on some matters.

Regarding the methods of refining control of the Void Secret Realm, and allowing the future controllers of the secret realm to continue to open the secret realm, to elevate the spiritual wills of many Evil Gods in the boundless void, and so on. “This creator of the secret realm, is rather benevolent.”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly, the creation of the Void Secret Realm offered virtually no benefits for the Tenth Stage creator, the beneficiaries were all those Evil Gods of Eighth and Ninth Stage.

After all, killing the Void Creatures within the secret realm can genuinely enhance one’s own spiritual will.

And the Evil Gods are already full of various kinds of madness, with strong spiritual will, they are even more likely to maintain their sanity. “Hmm?”

Soon, Lin Yuan had looked over all the stone pillars, and his gaze fell back on the first stone pillar.

This stone pillar had no specific information, only a complex pattern, which Lin Yuan initially didn’t pay much attention to. “A pattern that connects to a hidden space?”

Lin Yuan closely observed and finally used the Power of Space-Time to activate the power of the pathways.

Buzzing—

A faint suction enveloped Lin Yuan.

With Lin Yuan’s strength, a single thought could break free from this suction force, but he didn’t.

Swoosh.

Lin Yuan appeared on a mountaintop, and sitting on a boulder in the distance was a figure.

The figure wore a gray robe, only four to five meters tall, and at first glance seemed lifeless like a dry wood, also without ears or nose, having only five eyes and a mouth. “You must have also stepped into the Tenth Stage to have discovered this hidden space,” the gray-robed figure slowly spoke. “So, is this the creator of the secret realm?” Lin Yuan looked at the gray-robed figure, realizing it was only a residual image, similar to the ‘programs’ in the Main Universe human civilization, triggered by any life form entering it. “I do not know what era it is now, but in my boundless void, the emergence of a second Tenth Stage being is a good thing, a fortunate event,” the gray-robed figure continued.

The words spoken by the gray-robed figure were not a language but mental vibrations, comprehensible to any living being. “A second Tenth Stage?” Lin Yuan’s expression was unchanging. “After stepping into the Tenth Stage, I could feel the suppression from the boundless void, and also a fear from distant ages hence, I will die, if not now, then later.”

The gray-robed figure said.

Lin Yuan listened silently.

Even in the Main Universe, as long as one has not made the ultimate leap to free oneself from the shackles of the river of time, even the most powerful life forms will die.

It’s not a matter of lifespan, but when the universe collapses and destroys, the river of time will also collapse, and then all lives within it, unless they have broken free from the river’s shackles, will be destroyed alongside it.

The fear of death that the creator of the secret realm felt likely came from the end of this boundless void and the river of time entering destruction in a distant future. “My intuition tells me, if I want to continue to live, I must attempt that step.”

The gray-robed figure said, his tone revealing a slight fluctuation of anticipation and fear. “That step?” Lin Yuan pondered internally, which probably meant the ultimate leap, but as there were no predecessors in this boundless void, the gray-robed figure had no idea what realm he was actually trying to break into.

So he referred to it as ‘that step.’ “Attempting that step, I feel it’s extremely dangerous, but without attempting, I’m sure to die, so I have no choice,” the gray-robed figure continued to speak. “It likely failed,” Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Now he finally understood why he could not find any trace of the creator of the secret realm throughout the entire boundless void.

Attempting the ultimate would take one’s everything, including the life marks imprinted in this void, completely out of the river of time; and if it failed, one would totally disappear without leaving any trace.

If the creator of the secret realm had succeeded in the leap and become ultimate, he definitely would have returned to the boundless void.

Now, after such a long time without any news of him, it can only mean failure. “So, before attempting the leap, I decided to leave something for this boundless void, spent my energy to create this Void Secret Realm, and penned away the interstitial life forms outside the void.” “And—”

The gray-robed figure looked at Lin Yuan, “I have also prepared a gift for you, consider it a congratulatory gift.” …

The gray-robed figure gradually dissipated.

Lin Yuan stood there, plunged into silence.

Attempting the ultimate, if it fails, means complete destruction without any trace left.

The creator of the Void Secret Realm, a Tenth Stage Evil God, had a foundation even above those Level Eleven Perfect legendary life forms of the Main Universe, but he too failed in the ultimate attempt.

All his everything disappeared, leaving only a solitary Void Secret Realm. “Will I also end up like this in the future?”

Lin Yuan thought quietly to himself.

But in the blink of an eye, Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

He was different from the creator of the Void Secret Realm, who had no one before him and had to forge ahead by himself, where failure was all too normal.

Lin Yuan was backed by human civilization, with the experiences of many supreme beings and some precious means to enhance the likelihood of making the ultimate leap; the chances of success were definitely much greater than those of the secret realm’s creator.

Most importantly, Lin Yuan was currently only at the Tenth Stage, and when he steps into the Eleventh Stage, his foundation will undergo another comprehensive transformation, equally enhancing the opportunity to make the ultimate leap.

Utilizing his Against-Heaven’s Understanding…

Lin Yuan couldn’t guarantee he would definitely succeed in making the ultimate leap.

But he could definitely maximize the chances of making it. “So, the creator of the secret realm also left a gift? Is it a congratulatory gift?”

Lin Yuan looked towards the boulder where the gray-robed figure was, which also contained a vast space.

When Lin Yuan sent a sliver of his will to probe into it, his expression slightly changed. “These?”
